articles.title: Voyager 1 Goes Silent Just as It Hits a Record Distance
articles.summary: Voyager 1 has travelled a record one light-day from Earth, but a computer glitch has stopped its science data.

articles.title: A 309-Million-Year-Old Creature Gets a Name — and a Tribute
articles.summary: A fossil found years ago in Illinois turns out to be a new 309-million-year-old species, named for two students' mothers.

articles.title: Every Plant-Based Food Tested Had a Fungal Toxin — but Don't Panic
articles.summary: All 212 plant-based foods tested contained a fungal toxin, but every one was below EU safety guideline levels.
